description.value: Thaigo is a Thai fast-food chain operated by Broadway Foods Group, focused on delivering traditional Thai flavours quickly using fresh ingredients. The Park Royal location sits inside the Park Royal shopping centre food court in West Vancouver, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area. The brand has grown to four Metro Vancouver and Victoria locations since 2016.
